description.value: Rice Holic is a specialty dessert stall inside the Admiralty Centre Food Court in Richmond, best known for its fresh Mango Mochi — daily hand-picked mangoes individually wrapped in soft, chewy mochi dough and produced in limited quantities each day. The business also operates a second stall at Empire Centre on Number 3 Road. Online pre-order for in-person pickup is the standard way to secure an order.
